text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it! I can feel an 
incredible power coming from here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Goddess Statues, could this perhaps be... 
your doing?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth...? And yet, it feels so 
warm...
